reuse.why: Reuses getApproxNumberThreshold from shared/rules for the tolerance and getRangeAmount for ranges, and routes getScheduledAmount through the new helper.

duplication.why: Collapses five hand-written missing/number/range dispatches into getExpectedAmount; only a redundant null check survives in computeSchedulePreviewTransactions and getExpectedAmount/getScheduledAmount overlap.

placement.why: The rule lives in shared/schedules next to getRangeAmount and getScheduledAmount, reusing the threshold from shared/rules.

scope.why: Edits are limited to the sites that compute a schedule's expected amount, plus a focused test.

maintainability.why: The op parameter is optional, so every desktop-client getScheduledAmount caller (Balance, SchedulesTable, mobile lists, useScheduleEdit) silently keeps the old rule, and there are now two near-identical exported entry points.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Uses getApproxNumberThreshold and getRangeAmount rather than recomputing tolerance or range ends.

disguised_duplication.where: No duplicated logic; getScheduledAmount delegates to getExpectedAmount.

one_place.where: The rule is defined once in getExpectedAmount (shared/schedules.ts), but op is optional and desktop-client callers of getScheduledAmount (Balance.tsx, SchedulesTable.tsx, SchedulesListItem.tsx, MobileSchedulesPage.tsx, useScheduleEdit.ts) still call it without op, so those paths do not apply the approximate rule.
